caption: The drawing depicts a wooden box-like structure with three sides and a base, in which a seated figure is placed. The figure is wearing a black top hat with a wide brim, a dark green upper garment, and a long red skirt or robe with a green sash. The figure's right hand is clenched into a fist, and the left hand is open, palm facing up. The figure has brown shoes and is sitting on a ledge or seat attached to the right side of the box, with its legs hanging down. The walls and base of the wooden box are colored in worn shades of brown and tan, showing signs of aging and peeling. The left and back panels are decorated with red line drawings that include faces, angel-like figures with wings, and starburst patterns. The wood grain is visible throughout the box, and some areas appear chipped or battered, especially on the left side and the base. The overall composition centers the figure within the box, with the reddish garment standing out against the muted earth tones of the wood.
title: Santo (Bulto)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
